title: Triton Optimizer Multi-Agent Round Index
description: Aggregated metadata for all optimization rounds of a single operator.

round_dir.description: Directory name for this round, e.g. opt-round-3 or opt-round-3-switch

direction.description: Concrete optimization direction executed in this round

evidence_sources.description: Sources that supported the chosen direction

analysis_policy.description: Evidence depth policy used in this round

best_speedup.description: Best geometric-mean speedup achieved in this round

direction_yield.description: Causal quality label for this direction attempt

absolute_gain_vs_baseline.description: best_speedup minus the baseline speedup this round started from

baseline_dir.description: round_dir of the baseline code this round started from

consecutive_low_gain_count.description: Consecutive low-gain rounds for this direction

round_type.description: active if code changed vs historical best; idle if byte-identical

target_speedup.description: Target speedup configured for this round

design_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the design rationale and algorithm sketch for this round

iter_count.description: Number of coding/verification iterations performed in this round

opt_iter_count.description: Number of optimization iterations performed in Phase 4 of this round

key_fixes.description: List of key fixes or workarounds applied during this round

bottlenecks_observed.description: List of observed performance or compile bottlenecks during this round

parent_round_journal.description: Path to the parent round's detailed journal (round_journal.md)
